name: frontend-assets-error-text
title: assets-state: strip the error-code prefix from host errors and report coded denials to the banner
issue: Follow-up to the reviewed low finding on merged frontend PR #28. In src/renderer/assets-state.ts `messageOf` (around line 94) reads the raw error message, so a coded denial (the code travels as a U+2063-delimited message prefix, see errorCodeOf/errorTextOf in src/shared/api.ts and how src/renderer/inspector-state.ts handles it) would show the code glued to the host text; the catch blocks that save import settings and save a text file (around lines 346 and 475) set only the inline error. Fix: use errorTextOf in messageOf, and for a coded denial (readOnly/forbidden) in those catch blocks also call the state's error callback (store.reportError: banner + deniedAsReadOnly), keeping the inline error; plain failures stay inline only. Mirror what inspector-state.ts already does. Add unit/DOM tests (existing harness in src/test-dom and src/test) for both: coded denial shows clean text and reaches the banner callback; plain error unchanged. Run npm run typecheck, build and npm test; open a PR and wait for repo CI. No new dependencies; no other behaviour change.
acceptance: typecheck, build, npm test and frontend CI green
coded denial in assets saves shows clean text, reaches the banner, and latches read-only for readOnly
notes: Small follow-up; reviewer checks it mirrors inspector-state.ts and tests assert behaviour.
